description: This file defines various Data Transfer Object (DTO) classes used for handling request and response data, as well as error representation in a delivery management backend system. It includes classes for user registration, login, order creation and updates, and responses for user, order, package details, and tracking events.

classes.name: ErrorResponse
classes.description: Represents an error message with optional detailed errors, including a factory method to create an error response from model validation state.

classes.name: RegisterRequest
classes.description: DTO for user registration containing name, email, and password with validation annotations.

classes.name: LoginRequest
classes.description: DTO for user login containing email and password with validation annotations.

classes.name: CreateOrderRequest
classes.description: DTO for creating a new order with user id, origin, destination, and package details.

classes.name: PackageDetailsRequest
classes.description: Contains package description and dimensions, with a method to convert to model.

classes.name: TrackingEventResponse
classes.description: DTO for presenting tracking event data.

methods.name: ErrorResponse.FromModelState
methods.description: Constructs an ErrorResponse object from a ModelStateDictionary, extracting validation errors.

methods.name: PackageDetailsRequest.ToModel
methods.description: Converts a PackageDetailsRequest DTO to the corresponding domain model.

methods.name: UserResponse.FromModel
methods.description: Creates a UserResponse DTO from a User model object.

methods.name: OrderResponse.FromModel
methods.description: Creates an OrderResponse DTO from an Order model object.

methods.name: PackageDetailsResponse.FromModel
methods.description: Creates a PackageDetailsResponse DTO from a PackageDetails model object.

methods.name: TrackingEventResponse.FromModel
methods.description: Creates a TrackingEventResponse DTO from a TrackingEvent model object.
